correctness.rationale: PASS: Directly verified U_n=(b^n-(-1)^n)/(b+1), U4=m, and the generator-reduction identity U4+U4+t=bU_t(U4+U3)+(1+(-1)^t)U4. Coin exchange gives greedy optimality for 1,c,d, including the c=1 degenerate case; key shift inequality α(x+m)≥α(x)+c and Apéry representative minimality (other residues need x+tm) were reconstructed. Taking the Apéry maximum gives F, summing all α(x) gives the closed genus, and testing maximal Apéry residues under adding generators yields precisely two pseudo-Frobenius gaps (boundary x=cd-1 and x=m-1), including b=2. Fresh independent Dijkstra shortest paths for all 5,500 residues over b=2..12 corroborate exact Apéry, genus, F and PF; infinite b proof comes from exchange and residue arguments.
